Row.Text: 选择白绮后，内政、生产、建造与和平扩张永久由AI执行，支付正常成本；玩家查看内政，自行指挥军队并处理全部外交。[NEWLINE]选中相邻陆军，直接右键与敌城交互：击破外防且城市生命不高于35%时，可确认支付金币征取城市，并结束该军队本回合行动。

Administration, production, construction and peaceful expansion are permanently delegated at normal costs. You inspect cities, command the army and handle all diplomacy.[NEWLINE]Right-click an adjacent enemy city with eligible land troops. With outer defenses broken and city health at 35% or less, confirm the gold cost to requisition the city and end this unit's movement.
白绮，令城市为你运转，率军亲临战场。为我前驱。
Baiqi, let your cities work while you lead the army. Go forth for me.
暂无其他合适建设时，城市进行常规整备。不会额外招募单位或产生收益。
Routine preparations when no other suitable work is available. Grants no extra units or yields.
